subject: ACME demo: intermittent 500s in streaming SDK — repro playbook & triage
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: procurements@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Live demo today — intermittent 500s when using SDK streaming

Hi Sean,

We ran into repeated 500 responses and occasional connection resets during our internal demo this morning while using the Redwood JS SDK streaming path. The demo was hitting the hosted endpoint via our integration (SDK v1.11.2). Symptoms: streaming hangs at ~40-60 tokens then a 500 with error id in the log. I attached the error log excerpt (error-log-2027-02-27.txt).

Impact: demo blocked, procurement is asking for reliability detail before committing. Can your team triage urgently? If there's a safe rollback or flag we can flip on the account to avoid this during demos, we'd do it.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sr. Platform Engineer — ACME Health

Attachments: error-log-2027-02-27.txt

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Live demo today — intermittent 500s when using SDK streaming

Sarah — thanks for the quick heads up and for attaching the log. I'm looping in Soojin (sales-eng) and Karthik (runtime) to get a fast repro + mitigation.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the SDK config used (streaming_mode, keepalive, prefetch enabled/disabled) and a sample request id from the log (you included a short id but not the full trace).
- If you can toggle to non-streaming generation (single response) and confirm whether the 500s persist, that helps isolate streaming vs core model issue.

Planned next steps: schedule a 30-min triage today (I'll propose below). If we need a temporary account-level guardrail we can provision a canary flag to disable the adaptive proxy routing for ACME while the runtime team investigates.

Proposed triage slots (PST): 10:30, 13:00, 15:30. Which works?

—Sean
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:02:47 -0800
Subject: Re: Live demo today — intermittent 500s when using SDK streaming

Thanks for the ping. I looked at the short log excerpt — pattern looks familiar to a recent adaptive-proxy edge case we saw in canary: connections with streaming + prefetch off + long sequences (tokens > 2k) occasionally hit a race on our proxy reconnect path, producing 500 + "kv-cache-miss" style stack.

Immediate triage checklist (we need these artifacts to confirm):
- Full request_id(s) for one reproducer (from Sarah).
- Proxy access logs for the timeframe (we can pull if ACME is fine with us pulling from hosted logs) or Sarah can paste.
- Canary metrics screenshot (canary-metrics.png suggested).
- SDK version and exact config JSON.

Workarounds we can toggle today (account-level flags):
- disable adaptive_proxy_routing for the ACME account (fast, reversible).
- force sdk.streaming_mode = "single" (non-streaming) for demos.
- temporarily bump instance keepalive to 90s if connection resets are the issue.

I'll start a limited internal repro using SDK v1.11.2 and a similar payload. If I can repro locally I'll issue a hotfix to the proxy reconnect path; ETA TBD but we can scope severity after repro.

Karthik
Sr. Eng, Runtime — Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:15:09 -0800
Subject: Re: Live demo today — intermittent 500s when using SDK streaming

Sarah — following up with field repro notes from the demo attendee who ran the demo. Repro steps they used (I reproduced locally):
1) SDK: redwood-js v1.11.2
2) request payload: { model: "rw-instruct-3b", max_tokens: 4096, streaming: true, prefix: "Clinical summary:" }
3) prefetch: false (explicitly disabled in their wrapper)
4) observed behaviour: streaming yields ~45-70 tokens then either a connection reset or a 500 with error id: "err_7c9b2a"

Attached: error-log-2027-02-27.txt and a screenshot of canary metrics (canary-metrics.png). The screenshot shows an uptick in proxy reconnects at 09:06 PST matching their demo window. Additional notes:
- When we switched streaming:false the failures stopped.
- When we enabled prefetch:true the incidence dropped but didn't go to zero.

For the triage call we captured a single request id: rq_acme_demo_20270301_0906. Happy to provide a short Zoom recording of the tail if that helps.

Ask: Can runtime prioritize a short-lived account flag while we finalize the mitigation? Procurement is asking for a reliability workaround to move forward.

—Soojin
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: error-log-2027-02-27.txt, canary-metrics.png

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Live demo today — intermittent 500s when using SDK streaming

Team — summary & owners:
1) Short-term mitigation (owner: Karthik) — provision account flag to disable adaptive_proxy_routing for ACME Health. Karthik to confirm flag name & roll window by EOD 2027-03-04. This removes the proxy reconnect path from the request flow for ACME.
2) Repro/hotfix (owner: Karthik + Runtime) — reproduce locally using rq_acme_demo_20270301_0906 and SDK v1.11.2. If reproduced, patch proxy reconnect race and ship canary to infra. Target: reproduce verified by 2027-03-05, patch PR opened by 2027-03-08.
3) Field verification (owner: Soojin) — validate with ACME after flag rollout; confirm that streaming is stable for their demo use-cases.
4) Commercial (owner: Sean) — offer a one-week service credit for the demo failure and communicate mitigation to procurement.

Marissa will coordinate a single Slack thread for status updates. Karthik: if you need hosted logs I can authorize the pull for the rq id.

Thanks all — please reply with explicit ack and any date adjustments.

—Marissa
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-v1.docx
